title: Dutch roll dynamics -- yaw damper ON and OFF
objective: To demonstrate that the lateral/directional dynamic stability characteristics of the FSTD in the dutch roll mode conform to the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: ± 10% Dutch roll period | ± 0.02 or ± 20% damping ratio (zeta / T1/2 time to half amplitude)
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
